title: Erased customers reappear after the next full Silver/Gold rebuild
detail: build_silver rebuilds silver.customers from bronze.orders, where erased rows keep customer_id, and never reads governance.suppression_registry. Reproduced: after erasure and build_silver/build_gold, the customer is back in Silver and Gold.
meaning: A deleted customer comes back in reports every time the warehouse is fully rebuilt
impact: Target erasure must filter suppressed ids in every refresh or delete Bronze rows; add a regression test
risk: Recurring GDPR Art. 17 breach after cut-over full refreshes

title: Erasure and pipeline endpoints are public with no authentication and CORS *
detail: POST /erase/{id}, /erasure-requests, /transform, /produce, /sync-turso have no auth; CORS allows any origin with credentials; requested_by is hard-coded. Service is deployed publicly on Render and a HF Space.
meaning: Anyone on the internet can erase a customer or run the pipeline
impact: Serving layer is replaced (Databricks App with workspace auth / SQL warehouse ACLs), not re-pointed
risk: Irreversible erasures with no accountable requester

recommendation.reason: read in code and admitted in SECURITY.md

title: Raw Bronze PII is copied to third-party Turso
detail: sync_all_to_turso pushes bronze.orders (email, iban), bronze.clicks (ip_address) and bronze.payments (iban) to Turso; the Turso erasure cascade swallows errors and is not listed in layers_touched.
meaning: Clear-text email, IBAN and IP sit in a cloud database whose region is not proven EU
impact: Retire Turso in wave 1 or keep it inside the erasure job with verification
risk: PII left behind after erasure; residency breach

recommendation.reason: sync list and DDL read verbatim

title: Silver/Gold lake is pushed every 4 h to a Hugging Face dataset that erasure never reaches
detail: orchestrate.yml uploads data/lake to dataset swadhinbiswas/eustream; no private flag is set; dataset history keeps prior versions; seed_from_lake can reload it into an empty warehouse.
meaning: Pseudonymised customer data is published outside the company's control
impact: Decide: retire, make private, or replace with Delta Sharing to named recipients
risk: Erased customers remain retrievable from dataset history

title: Event bus keeps full PII payloads with no retention and erasure does not reach it
detail: Producers publish the whole event model (email, iban, ip_address) to topics; SQLite messages table has no TTL; README states the bus is not purged by erasure.

evidence.excerpt: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
The local event bus is not purged by an erasure request

meaning: Personal data stays forever in the message log even after a customer is erased
impact: Target ingestion needs topic retention limits and Bronze as the only long-term copy
risk: Replays re-ingest erased PII

title: Hard-coded public default PII salt
detail: PII_SALT = 'eurostream-pii-salt' is the default of Settings.pii_salt; nothing fails when EUROSTREAM_PII_SALT is unset, so hashes can be reversed by dictionary on emails.
meaning: Pseudonymised emails may be re-identifiable if the default salt was ever used
impact: Target reads the salt from a Databricks secret scope; existing hashes may need re-keying
risk: Changing the salt breaks history joins; keeping it keeps the exposure

title: A Databricks port already runs in DEV but its source was removed from the repo
detail: DEV has bundle eurostream-free: 3 serverless Lakeflow pipelines and 4 jobs in catalog eurostream. Commit c78138d removed databricks/; 18 tests under tests/databricks now fail and CI job databricks-app points to a missing folder.
meaning: Part of the migration is already built, but nobody can review or redeploy it from source
impact: Recover the bundle source first; scope becomes 'finish and harden' rather than 'build'
risk: Estimating from zero double-counts work; or DEV diverges unseen

recommendation.reason: read live and reproduced with pytest

title: DEV workspace metastore is in us-east-2 while ADR-0001 requires EU-only processing
detail: Metastore metastore_aws_us_east_2 reports region us-east-2; ADR-0001 pins all storage and processing to EU regions and forbids non-EU processing.

evidence.excerpt: All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions:

meaning: The Databricks environment used so far is in the US, against the client's own residency decision
impact: Target workspace must be provisioned in an EU region; DEV data must be synthetic only
risk: Real customer data processed in the US

recommendation.reason: observed live; matches posture check VX-RES-1

title: Kafka producer reports fake offsets and drops failed sends silently
detail: KafkaProducer.produce returns RecordMetadata(partition=0, offset=0) before delivery; failures are only logged in the delivery callback, no retry or raise.
meaning: Events can be lost on the way to Kafka without anyone noticing
impact: Producers are upstream; flag to the source-system owners; target ingest reconciles counts
risk: Missing orders/payments in reporting

title: Fraud scorer state and bus offsets are saved separately
detail: FraudScorer.checkpoint writes JSON non-atomically and independent of committed offsets; the processor emits the alert before commit, with no alert dedup key.
meaning: After a restart fraud alerts can be duplicated or windows double-counted
impact: Rewrite with Structured Streaming checkpoints (state + offsets together)
risk: Alert counts in Gold drift from reality

title: Incremental Silver drops late and corrected events
detail: Incremental load selects occurred_at > watermark and INSERT OR IGNOREs into silver.orders/payments; events with older event time or corrected rows never land. Its result always reports orders: 0, payments: 0.
meaning: The scheduled run and a full rebuild produce different numbers
impact: Target uses AUTO CDC / watermarks with allowed lateness; reconcile against a full rebuild
risk: Parallel-run reconciliation fails for reasons in the legacy, not the target

title: Consent quality check cannot fail
detail: consent_gating compares consents_marketing with marketing_consent; build_gold writes both from c.marketing_consent, so the check always passes. No marketing view filters non-consenting customers.

evidence.excerpt: "SELECT count(*) c FROM gold.customer_360 WHERE consents_marketing <> marketing_consent"

meaning: The consent safeguard the documents promise is not actually enforced
impact: Build a consent-gated view or row filter in Gold and a real test
risk: Marketing use of customers without consent

title: Erasure audit claims the lake was cleaned when only a hook exists
detail: execute() appends 'lake' to layers_touched if on_complete is set, writes the audit, then runs the hook and swallows its errors.
meaning: The audit trail can state a layer was erased when it was not
impact: Target audit records per-store verification results, written after the work
risk: Audit evidence that does not hold up to a regulator

title: SQL built by string interpolation in the verify endpoint
detail: /verify-erasure/{customer_id} interpolates the path parameter into five SQL statements (noqa S608).

evidence.excerpt: f"SELECT count(*) FROM gold.customer_360 WHERE customer_id='{customer_id}'"  # noqa: S608

meaning: A crafted customer id can run arbitrary SQL against the warehouse
impact: Not carried: the endpoint is replaced; target uses parameterised queries
risk: Data exposure through a public endpoint until retired

title: Health endpoint publishes every erased customer id
detail: GET /health returns erasure.suppressed_customers() unauthenticated.
meaning: The list of people who asked to be forgotten is public
impact: Target restricts the suppression list to the DPO group
risk: Disclosure of data-subject requests

title: Dashboard shows literal fallback numbers and two tabs never load
detail: fetchTabData loads on 'medallion' but tabs are 'warehouse'/'ops'; charts fall back to literals (65/50/75, 18/6, 124.50) and /stats falls back to the HF dataset with a wrong key mapping.
meaning: Numbers on screen may not come from the data at all
impact: Consumers are rebuilt (AI/BI dashboard or App), not ported; no rules to carry
risk: Users compare the new dashboard to invented baseline numbers

title: Warehouse state lives only in an evictable GitHub Actions cache
detail: orchestrate.yml caches data/eurocart.duckdb and events.db keyed on the PII manifest hash; a cache miss starts an empty warehouse, which the API then seeds from the public dataset.
meaning: There may be no durable copy of the full history to migrate
impact: History backfill source must be agreed (Turso, HF, or the Kafka log)
risk: Backfill from the wrong copy brings back erased customers

title: Scheduled run silently switches from Kafka to SQLite on any probe error
detail: The Kafka probe writes backend=sqlite on any exception, so the run continues on a different, empty bus; a missing HF_TOKEN also exits 0.
meaning: A run can report success while processing nothing from the real bus
impact: Target job fails loudly on source unavailability
risk: Gaps in history nobody noticed

title: Single-writer embedded stores shared across threads and processes
detail: SQLite bus uses one connection with check_same_thread=False guarded by an in-process lock; the API shares one DuckDB connection across request threads while CI and API can both write.
meaning: The current design cannot scale beyond one writer, the stated driver for moving
impact: Resolved by target: Delta tables with concurrent writers
risk: Low after migration

title: Gold rebuild is DELETE then INSERT without a transaction
detail: build_gold deletes gold.customer_360, order_facts and fraud_summary and reinserts in separate statements; a failure leaves Gold partially empty for readers.
meaning: The dashboard can briefly show empty or partial Gold data
impact: Resolved by target: materialized views refresh atomically
risk: Low after migration

title: SQLite consumer can commit past an unprocessed message
detail: poll() advances the in-memory position before processing and close() commits it, so a shutdown between poll and processing skips a record.
meaning: An event can be skipped on shutdown
impact: Resolved by target streaming checkpoints
risk: Small, silent data loss in the legacy history

title: PII manifest registers only two of the PII columns
detail: governance/pii_manifest.json lists bronze.orders email and iban only; bronze.payments.iban and bronze.clicks.ip_address are absent though erasure masks them.
meaning: The register of personal-data columns is incomplete
impact: Target tags every PII column in Unity Catalog from the inventory, not this file
risk: Untagged PII escapes masks and erasure

title: Production has no environment separation or deploy approval
detail: orchestrate runs on cron and on every push to master writing to Turso/HF; Render autoDeploy and HF Space deploy on push; Terraform defaults environment to prod with no state backend.
meaning: Any merge immediately changes production data and the public site
impact: Target uses bundle targets dev/staging/prod with a service principal and approvals
risk: Untested changes hit production

title: DEV pipelines and jobs run as a named person
detail: All three Lakeflow pipelines report run_as_user_name of an individual user and live under that user's .bundle path; posture check GOV-42 flags the jobs too.
meaning: The DEV port depends on one person's account
impact: Target deploys with a service principal via bundle
risk: Pipelines stop when the person leaves

title: Assessment service principal cannot see catalog eurostream
detail: The read-only SP lists catalogs workspace, system, samples and sat only; the pipelines write to catalog eurostream, so its tables, grants and lineage could not be inventoried.
meaning: The Databricks-side tables of the DEV port are invisible to this assessment
impact: Grant USE CATALOG + BROWSE on eurostream to the assessment SP to complete L4
risk: DEV table inventory and lineage stay unknown

title: Documents disagree with each other and with the code on key behaviour
detail: Fraud window type (fixed vs rolling vs tumbling), batch mode (re-read earliest vs incremental), erasure steps (architecture vs erasure flow) and target warehouse (ADR: Snowflake/BigQuery; README: Databricks) conflict.

evidence.excerpt: - Re-reads the durable event log from `earliest`

meaning: The documents cannot be used as the specification without review
impact: Code-derived rules (business_rules register) become the spec, owners confirm CONFLICTs
risk: Building from docs reproduces behaviour the system does not have

title: docker-compose maps port 8000 but the image serves 7860
detail: Dockerfile EXPOSE/CMD use 7860; docker-compose maps 8000:8000 and health-checks localhost:8000.
meaning: The local container setup does not start a reachable API
impact: None for the target; note for anyone reproducing the legacy
risk: Low
